categories.main_business_segments: CSSC Offshore & Marine Engineering (Group) Company Limited (COMEC) operates primarily in four sectors: maritime defense equipment, maritime transport equipment, maritime development equipment, and maritime technology application equipment. Its main products include military ships, marine police equipment, public service ships, feeder containerships, bulk carriers, gas carriers, dredgers, offshore engineering platforms, wind power installation platforms, and emerging products such as energy equipment, high-end steel structures, construction machinery, and industrial internet platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The Group employs advanced shipbuilding technologies including regional general assembly shipbuilding mode and simultaneous construction of multiple vessel types. It emphasizes innovation-driven and technology-led strategies, focusing on green, energy-saving, and environment-friendly ship types, as well as high-tech and high value-added vessels. The company has 13 provincial and ministerial-level science and technology innovation platforms and utilizes intelligent manufacturing and advanced digital workshops to enhance production efficiency and quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The Company serves primarily state-owned enterprises, foreign enterprises, and private enterprises, with a significant portion of sales to state-owned enterprises. Its customers include military and public service sectors, shipping companies, and offshore wind power projects. The top five customers accounted for 88.08% of total sales, indicating a concentrated customer base. Major end markets include domestic China (including Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan) and overseas markets, with a growing share in foreign markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: COMEC operates mainly in China, including Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan, with significant sales and operations in other Asian regions, Europe, Oceania, North America, and Africa. The company has a strong domestic presence and expanding international footprint, particularly in offshore wind power steel structures in the UK and global shipbuilding markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The Group operates primarily in the midstream segment of the shipbuilding and offshore engineering industrial chain, focusing on assembly and construction. It extends its operations to upstream shipbuilding and offshore supporting products and downstream whole-life support services. The company also engages in procurement and logistics services through its controlling shareholder China Shipbuilding Group.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: COMEC prioritizes innovation and leadership in green and intelligent shipbuilding, focusing on proprietary vessel models such as methanol dual-fuel vessels, ammonia dual-fuel gas carriers, and medium-sized containerships. It invests heavily in R&D, with increased expenses and a large R&D staff, aiming to enhance technological capabilities, optimize product structures, and promote digital and intelligent manufacturing processes. The company also emphasizes military-civilian integration and green transformation aligned with national strategies.
categories.revenue_model: The Company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of shipbuilding products, offshore engineering products, steel structure engineering, ship maintenance and modification services, and electro-mechanical products. Revenue is recognized mainly from fixed-price contracts based on customer orders, with income derived from both domestic and international markets. The company also earns investment income from associates and joint ventures.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: COMEC is a large-scale backbone shipbuilding enterprise under China Shipbuilding Group and a national core military production enterprise. It holds leading positions in China and globally in markets such as feeder containerships, dredgers, military ships, and public service ships. The company benefits from strong brand recognition, technological advantages, and a diversified product portfolio, positioning it as a key player in the shipbuilding and offshore engineering industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, COMEC achieved operating income of RMB 19.4 billion, a 20.17% year-on-year increase, and a net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 377 million, a 684.86% increase from the previous year. The company’s total assets reached RMB 53.6 billion, with steady growth in net assets and equity. Despite negative net cash flows from operating activities due to expanded production scale, the company maintains a strong financial position with increasing profitability and investment income.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: COMEC emphasizes its capabilities in producing high-quality, technologically advanced, and environmentally friendly vessels, including proprietary designs like methanol and ammonia dual-fuel ships. Its strengths lie in lean management, efficient production processes, and a diversified product portfolio that meets both military and civilian needs. The company’s integration of innovation, green transformation, and digital manufacturing provides competitive differentiation and aligns with global trends towards sustainable and intelligent shipbuilding.
